title: RAW COMBINED CONTRACT: complete f83r procedures with independently localized scene arguments
summary: User-requested combination of compositional statements and image-supplied arguments. The existing complete f83r prose-to-scene map fixes four local scene environments; it does not fix individual word ownership or five distinct people. Author and compare a scene-local procedural reading against a continuous cross-scene reading on the complete page, with one shared lexical grammar and explicit reference obligations. No Voynich value is assigned in this contract.

actual_available_candidate.scope: Whole page: all 341 prose positions in the seven existing source records plus the four complete captions, not the old95-position music subset. Exact source rows and reader-specific segmentation govern implementation; 341 is the published record total, not a new count.
actual_available_candidate.no_new_visual_test_needed: The paragraph-to-scene assignment is already explicit in the claim-bearing report. A new observation of that same assignment would repeat work. Its weakness is semantic argument scope, not absence of a physical block map.
actual_available_candidate.image_payload_allowed: Four separate local scene environments with the reported depicted figure instances and conservative component inventory. Component instances are image variables only. No direction, substance, temperature, act, sex role, simultaneous person count or cross-panel personal identity follows from the pictures.

design.mechanism: The writer omits an already displayed scene argument but writes the predicate, quantification, modification and reference transitions. The reader inserts only the locally licensed pictured environment into that written construction.
design.unit: Seven complete physical prose records and four whole captions under four fixed scene environments.
design.contrast: Local instructional use of each picture versus a continuous account carrying participants through successive pictures; retain a third descriptive-inventory rival. They must use the same proposed word values wherever identical exact forms recur, within each reader.
design.primary_reading_content: Each main panel is a worked practical case: the prose specifies what is to be done using the depicted arrangement, in which order, under which conditions and with which resulting state. The displayed participants/apparatus provide referential arguments, not the action meanings. No medical material, operation or word is named from its appearance.
finite_reference_contract: At each distinct panel boundary create a local scene environment. A depicted figure instance is a local referential variable, not a new actual person by default.
Within P4/P5 keep the same lower-scene environment but respect the two complete record boundaries. Do not silently reset merely to resolve a contradiction.
Q1/Q2 are subordinate local records of the same lower panel. Do not assign them automatically to a particular outlet; no singular leader ownership is bound.

Under the primary local reading, an unexpressed external argument can resolve only to a compatible local scene variable. If several are compatible, retain the full ambiguity rather than choosing by expected story.

A nonlocal participant, changed role, distributive application or collective binary action requires a shared written construction. There is no free left/right selector, image-specific verb or occurrence-indexed repair.
Under the serial rival, continuity across panels must be written or derived by one prospective shared discourse rule. The images alone cannot assert same-person-before/after or a timeline.
All four captions must receive complete compositional readings as noun phrase, predicate or reference, with their whole source spelling retained; a noun-only rule is disallowed by1032.
complete_authoring_obligations: Read every exact form profile and claim-bearing prior evidence BEFORE proposing any native meaning; assess standalone versus embedded forms and separate readers. This contract supplies no such assignment.

Cover all tokens in all seven records and four captions under one finite reusable grammar. Unknown values may remain explicit during exploration, but a complete-reading result requires them resolved; no claim from a convenient excerpt.

For every clause list predicate, arguments, source of each argument (written or image), scope, antecedent, precondition and consequence. An inferred participant cannot be silently introduced by a German paraphrase.
Preserve original separator uncertainty and alternate whole readings. Do not inherit old musical, HOT/END or material labels as lexical facts.
Retain textual clause boundaries as proposals; physical lines are not automatically sentences. Complete physical records constrain cross-record references but do not supply sentence syntax.
distinguishable_prediction: If the same written construction entails an operation on TWO DISTINCT local participants, applying it in any of the three one-figure panels must find its second participant explicitly in the text or in independently typed local apparatus; it cannot manufacture a second person. Conversely, two depicted figures alone do not select a collective reading.

A proposed continuation whose reference crosses from P1 toP2 orP2 toP3 must behave differently under the local reset and serial-persistence readings. The later written consumer must require the particular earlier result or participant; matching an opening formula is insufficient.

For the lower panel, a genuinely distributive reading must entail separately evaluable consequences for both recipients, while a collective reading entails a relation of the pair. Two compatible positive descriptions do not distinguish them (866). A written asymmetric continuation or exclusive result would distinguish them if a complete common parse derives it.

The completed account must identify at least one concrete scene/referral change that makes it false or changes a required action while the unchanged rival remains possible. Generic true statements, all-token coverage and an executable story alone are not evidence (980).
design.smallest_actual_manuscript_step: Root may select the existing whole f83r packet for manual authoring, beginning with P1–P3 and the lower P4/P5 continuity contrast but preserving the full-page obligation. First inspect the existing exact-form profiles of proposed recurring construction heads; draft the local and serial alternatives side by side without old gloss inheritance. Select no glyph key, image recount or generic classifier. If no written reference/arity consequence emerges, retain the attempt as incomplete rather than counting picture compatibility.
design.independence: The old physical map is external to this new proposed lexical grammar but historically exposed; it is not blinded confirmation. No p-value or independent folio replication is available from four scenes on one page.
